definitions: P means uniform deterministic polynomial time. RP allows uniform randomized polynomial time with no acceptance on no-instances and acceptance probability at least one half on yes-instances. NP permits polynomial-size certificates checked in deterministic polynomial time. The source discusses \(\mathrm P\subseteq\mathrm{RP}\subseteq\mathrm{NP}\).
